name: The Touch of Zanzil
summary: Doc Mixilpixil asks you to gather supplies for the 'itis'. He says the ailment will not cure itself.

sections.title: A Doctor's Request
sections.body: Doc Mixilpixil needs you to bring him Simple Wildflowers, a Leaded Vial, a Bronze Tube, and a Spool of Light Chartreuse Silk Thread. He says the 'itis' needs a cure, and these are the supplies he asks you to bring.

faq.q: Who is asking for these supplies?
faq.answer: Doc Mixilpixil asks you to bring the supplies.
He needs Simple Wildflowers, a Leaded Vial, a Bronze Tube, and a Spool of Light Chartreuse Silk Thread.
Doc Mixilpixil calls the ailment the 'itis'.
